page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Large capitals at the top, then smaller lines of centred text in the middle, then a short imprint at the foot. A library stamp (BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS) lies over the centre and is left out.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and show-through from the reverse is strong. Only the largest capitals at the top and the date line at the foot are reasonably legible, and even these are doubtful. Most of the middle lines could not be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible. The library stamp (BIBLIOTHECA REGIA MONACENSIS) is not transcribed. The image may be a higher-resolution scan of the page if a clearer copy is available.
